empty_root_science_coverage.interpretation: The authorized evidence replay reaches G8, but the current graph does not represent a complete empty-root regeneration of all mapped science.

execution_classification_policy.empty_root_counting_rule: A scientific node counts only when every mapped assertion is FRESH_RECOMPUTE.
execution_classification_policy.empty_root_definition: The generated-data root starts empty. Source code, specifications and declared immutable input fixtures may be present; restored or historical outputs do not count as freshly generated science.
execution_classification_policy.node_effective_class_rule: Use the least fresh/most historically dependent assertion class present in the node.
